paper_title: Модели за проследяване на публикационната активност на изследователи
caption: База от данни: нормативен контрол и верификация на данните
model_annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories related to "Нормативен контрол (контролни файлове)" or "Normative control (control files)". The chart is divided into five sectors, including "имена" (names) with a blue color, taking up approximately 25% of the chart, "рубрики" (rubrics) in red, also occupying around 25%, "идентификатори на имена (ORCID, ResearcherID и др.)" (identifiers of names) in green, making up about 25%, "контрол и верификация на данните" (control and verification of data) in light blue, covering around 25%, and "групи" (groups) in purple, representing about 5%. The chart includes callout labels for each sector, displaying their labels and values, and the sectors appear to be arranged in no particular order.
